name: Paradise
description: The tranquility in a serene, wealthy community inhabited by some of the world's most prominent individuals explodes when a shocking murder occurs and a high stakes investigation unfolds.

videos.title: Wildcat Is Down
videos.overview: It's just another day in Paradise until Agent Xavier Collins discovers one of the world's most powerful individuals has been viciously murdered. Xavier analyzes the crime scene while recalling his complex relationship with the victim.

videos.title: Sinatra
videos.overview: Agent Xavier Collins is interrogated. Samantha Redmond (codename Sinatra) begins to reassure the community as she reflects on how she got to Paradise.

videos.title: The Architect of Social Well-Being
videos.overview: Isolated, Xavier seeks answers on his own and cautiously turns to Dr. Gabriela Torabi. Meanwhile, Billy and Jane feel the pressure from Robinson's investigation.

videos.title: Agent Billy Pace
videos.overview: The citizens of Paradise celebrate at the annual carnival. Xavier and Billy delve deeper into their investigation.

videos.title: In the Palaces of Crowned Kings
videos.overview: Xavier faces the consequences of his investigation, forcing him to consider how to proceed. Meanwhile Cal's family history and his last days are examined.

videos.title: You Asked for Miracles
videos.overview: Xavier and Robinson set their plans in motion while Sinatra works to preserve the status quo in Paradise.

videos.title: The Day
videos.overview: Sinatra and Xavier confront the past, returning to the harrowing day that brought them to Paradise.

videos.title: The Man Who Kept the Secrets
videos.overview: Xavier and Robinson race to find President Bradford’s murderer before it's too late.

videos.title: Graceland
videos.overview: Annie is a tour guide in Memphis, TN when the world ends. Her survival in the ensuing years after The Day is revealed as well as her encounter with a traveling group of survivors.

videos.title: Mayday
videos.overview: Xavier battles the elements and other threats as he follows a broadcast to Atlanta in search of his wife, Teri.

videos.title: Another Day in Paradise
videos.overview: Sinatra wakes to discover a new paradigm in the bunker and takes steps to safeguard its biggest secret.

videos.title: A Holy Charge
videos.overview: Xavier and Annie travel to Atlanta, contrasting life in this new world and the one he left behind in the bunker.

videos.title: The Mailman
videos.overview: Xavier meets Gary and learns what happened to Teri on The Day.

videos.title: Jane
videos.overview: Xavier and Gary set their plan in motion. Back in Paradise, Sinatra takes action, while Gabriela follows a new lead, and Jane's past is revealed.

videos.title: The Final Countdown
videos.overview: Xavier has unfinished business. Meanwhile, Sinatra meets with Link as Paradise prepares for a potential threat.

videos.title: Exodus
videos.overview: Worlds collide. Time is of the essence for Xavier. Link and his team spring into action. Sinatra puts it all on the line.

awards: Nominated for 4 Primetime Emmys. 10 wins & 31 nominations total
